description: Source code for invoking and demonstrating the use of RboxPoints and Qhull libraries from C++, including functions for convex hull, Delaunay triangulation, and Voronoi diagram computations, with command-line interface handling.

classes.name: RboxPoints
classes.description: Class for generating and handling Rbox points, used for geometric input data.

classes.name: Qhull
classes.description: Class encapsulating Qhull computations for convex hull, Delaunay triangulation, and Voronoi diagrams.

classes.name: QhullError
classes.description: Exception class for handling Qhull errors.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point demonstrating command-line invocation of Rbox and Qhull functionalities.

methods.name: user_eg3
methods.description: Function executing various Qhull and Rbox commands based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: printDoubles
methods.description: Prints a vector of doubles with formatting.

methods.name: qconvex_o
methods.description: Outputs convex hull data using std::vector and C++ classes.

methods.name: qdelaunay_o
methods.description: Outputs Delaunay triangulation data using std::vector and C++ classes.

methods.name: qvoronoi_o
methods.description: Outputs Voronoi diagram data for a given Qhull object.

methods.name: qvoronoi_pfn
methods.description: Outputs Voronoi vertices at infinity and their regions.

methods.name: qvoronoi_fifo
methods.description: Outputs Voronoi hyperplanes between regions using QhullUser and qh_fprintf.
